issues.where: the lower half and right side of the globe at peak swirl
issues.what: the petal trails merge into broad, nearly parallel pink-white bands that flatten the depth and nearly erase the pond, bank, and trunk at normal size
issues.fix: Keep the strong swirl, but shorten and vary trails by depth and velocity, reduce the overlapping bright trails at the front, and keep a few gaps through to the scene.

issues.where: crops 10–11, the near bank between the pond and the moss collar
issues.what: the bank drops into a broad, almost uniformly green cut face that reads like the exposed side of a solid foam insert
issues.fix: Build a layered bank with soil, fine roots, and irregular turf depth, and use the lower glass to refract and partly obscure the edge.

issues.where: crop 8, the little cascade on the front-left of the base
issues.what: the cascade reads as a smooth, detached clear ribbon with bright rails; adjacent rock shows little change where the water runs over it
issues.fix: Make the flow cling to the contours of the stone, vary its width and thickness, and darken the wetted rock around the channel.

issues.where: crop 11, pond surface beneath the lantern reflection
issues.what: broad, smooth silver-pink folds run across the pond like molded waves, with little small-scale disturbance along the bank
issues.fix: Reduce the large wave amplitude near the shore and break the mirror with smaller, irregular ripples and local disturbance around stones and floating petals.
